_comment.owner_ids: Full bot ownership — can generate premium keys, reload cogs, shutdown bot.
_comment.dev_ids: Developer-level access — same as owner for most privileged commands.
_comment.dev_role_ids: Discord role IDs that grant developer-level access within any guild. Leave empty if unused.
_comment.note: Add additional Discord user IDs (integers) to the arrays above. Do not add quotes around them.
